76:1: Has there not come and passed over man a period of time when he was not a mentioned thing?
76:2: Indeed, We created man from a mixed nutfah, We test him, therefore We made him hearing and seeing.
76:3: Indeed, We guided him to the way, either as grateful or as ungrateful.
76:4: Indeed, We prepared for the disbelievers chains, iron collars, and a blazing fire.
76:5: Indeed, the righteous drink from a cup whose mixture is Kafur.
76:6: A spring from which the servants of Allah drink, which they cause to gush forth flowing.
76:7: They fulfill their vows and fear a day whose evil is widespread.
76:8: And they feed food, despite love for it, to the poor, the orphan, and the captive.
76:9: We feed you only for the face of Allah; we desire no reward from you nor thanks.
76:10: Indeed, we fear from our Rabb a grim, distressful day.
76:11: So Allah protected them from the evil of that day and gave them radiance and joy.
76:12: And in return for their patience, He gave them a garden and silk.
76:13: There they recline upon couches; they see there neither burning heat nor freezing cold.
76:14: And its shades are hung low over them, and its fruits are made easy to reach.
76:15: And vessels of silver and goblets that are crystal are circulated among them.
76:16: Crystals of silver which they have determined by a measure.
76:17: There they are given to drink a cup whose mixture is ginger.
76:18: A spring therein that is named Salsabil.
76:19: And around them circulate children made eternal; when you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.
76:20: Whenever you look, there you will see bliss and a great kingdom.
76:21: Upon them are garments of fine green silk and thick silk. They are adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Rabb gives them a pure drink.
76:22: Indeed, this is a reward for you, and your effort has been appreciated.
76:23: Indeed, We, it is We who sent down the Quran to you.
76:24: So be patient for the judgment of your Rabb, and do not obey a sinner or an ungrateful one among them.
76:25: And remember the name of your Rabb morning and evening.
76:26: And during a part of the night prostrate to Him, and glorify Him a long part of the night.
76:27: Indeed, those people love the hasty, and leave behind them a heavy day.
76:28: We created them and strengthened their joints, and if We will, We can replace them with their likes.
76:29: Indeed, this is a reminder; so whoever wills takes a way to his Rabb.
76:30: And you do not will unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is Knowing, Wise.
76:31: He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And for the wrongdoers, He has prepared a painful punishment.
